'''Nogometni Klub Žepče 1919''' is a [[football (soccer)|football]] club from [[Zepce|Žepče]], Bosnia and Herzegovina.

The home stadium is called [[Žepče Gradski Stadion]] (Žepče City Stadium) with a capacity of 4,000.<ref>{{cite web |title=Potpisan ugovor o dodjeli nogometnog stadiona nogometnom klubu zepce 1919 |url=https://zepce.ba/sport/item/7897-potpisan-ugovor-o-dodjeli-nogometnog-stadiona-nogometnom-klubu-zepce-1919 |website=zepce.ba |access-date=27 July 2021}}</ref> The team plays in the third [[League Druga Liga Centar]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Članovi Saveza |url=http://nszdk.com/index.php/o-savezu/clanovi-saveza |website=Nogometni/Fudbalski Savez Zeničko - dobojskog kantona |access-date=27 July 2021}}</ref> The team's colours are blue and white."}}
